name: bd
description: Track, create, claim, and close repo issues with the bd (beads) tool, including dependency links.

interface.longDescription: Runs the bd command line issue tracker against a repository: list what is ready to pick up, create and claim and close issues, and record which issue blocks which. Use it to answer what to work on next from the repository's own issue graph.
defaultPrompt: What can I pick up next?
Create a bd issue for this and block it on the current one.
